work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCLXIX to Alexis Bachelot, prefect apostolic of the Sandwich Islands mission (address LF46449–46455, protocol LF46458), praises the missionaries' labours and exile, urges perseverance, notes that the requested faculties were granted through Propaganda Fide, and ends with its own 27 September 1833 closing at LF46486–46489, before numeral CCLXX at LF46492. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF46458–46458; the source closing at LF46486–46489 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub:annulo piscatoris die vigesima septima septembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo tertio, pontificatus Nostri anno tertio. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
